properties.section: Section 3D: Hydraulic Road to Earhart Street
properties.description:
Mile 7.6-8.0
Easy - but there you do have to go through two culverts. 

Next, you will traverse under Hydraulic Drive via the Meadow Creek culvert and climb up to a sidewalk/bridge that crosses over Meadow Creek before quickly dropping back down on the left to another culvert that takes you under the bypass (Rte 25) and to Meadow Creek Gardens Park.

After leaving Meadow Creek Gardens follow Morton Drive (ROAD WALK) across Emmet Street (HWY 29) to Earhart street and look for the RTF bridge and Trailhead sign on your left. 

Type: RTF Main Trail - rustic/road walk

properties.section: Section 6A: Fontaine Ave to Moore's Creek
properties.description:
12.09.2025 Update: Due to multiple construction projects in this area with UVA and RWSA part of this section of trail is closed till mid January. 

Mile 13.45-14.2
Moderate - but ends at a very difficult creek crossing

Cross Fontaine Ave and rejoin the RT main loop near the 250 off-ramp. The trail heads into the woods and up towards the Fountain Research Center (parking is still available but it is more difficult to access the trail with the construction fence up). Continue towards Natural Resources Drive, follow RTF signs and cross the road to the new boardwalk. 

When the trail pops onto Stribling Avenue turn right and after crossing under the railroad bridge turn right again through the field. Cross the  old driveway, and descend to the rock hop (when water level is low) across Moore's Creek. Use caution crossing the creek, water levels can vary quite a bit. 

Type: RTF Main Trail - rustic/mostly single track

properties.section: Section 8C: Monticello Ave to Woolen Mills
properties.description:
Mile 20.0 - 21.55
Moderate/difficult (rocky terrain) 

The trail continues under Monticello Avenue (rte 20), and hugs Moore's Creek as it makes its way to the Rivanna River. Be prepared to scramble over rocks, trample through sand, and see a variety of wildlife, exposed rock cliffs, the old livestock market, and historic mill buildings. Note that some parts of this section are particularly rocky and uneven. Cross the pedestrian bridge, turn right through the Woolen Mills property to Market Street. 

Type: RTF Main Trail

properties.Name: Rivanna Trail

properties.description:
Mile 11.55-13.45
Difficult - several hills

After crossing Ivy Road the trail re-enters the woods near the 250 bypass off-ramp. Keep your eyes open for RTF blazes that mark the main path through Observatory Hill--there are numerous mountain biking trails throughout this section, so it can be confusing. A good rule of thumb is to stay low and to the right. 

Type: RTF Main Trail
